limitations: a converted record is a candidate, not an attestation: nothing here is signed
a truncated commit prefix is resolved against the declared harness repository and verified against the prefix; an unresolvable prefix is treated as a missing pin
the harness version is read from the harness repository at the pinned commit
heldOut is absent, which means unknown and not false: no publisher in this corpus states whether its item set was sequestered from the system under test
contamination is absent, which means the question was not asked

the Wilson interval is computed only for metrics that are means of 0/1 indicators and only when at least two instances were scored; a metric outside that set carries no interval rather than a borrowed one
an item set that was subsampled records the original and the effective count

the direction of each metric is recorded outside the predicate, because EvaluationResult/v1 has no field for it; that gap is the subject of the OTel crosswalk at docs/OTEL-GENAI-EVALUATION-CROSSWALK.md
